🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad internals (10/11) showing strength alongside rising credit stress via HYG/LQD ratio falling; conflicted by complacent VXX (VXX (1W: -4.01% | 1M: -14.70%) BELOW TREND) and neutral SPY_TLT, hence caution.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.55%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND but HYG/LQD ratio ↓ → credit risk signal ↑. Fear easing: VXX (1W: -4.01% | 1M: -14.70%) BELOW TREND; Stocks vs Bonds flat: SPY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY vs TLT (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-cautious: UUP (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +1.60%) CORRECTION while yield curve rising (↑) and duration preference ABOVE TREND; overall conditions mixed with mild tightening signals.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Growth/momentum leading: XLK (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) ABOVE TREND and semis SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing strength via sector breadth XLF (1W: +2.89% | 1M: +5.54%) ABOVE TREND. Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND.

5. US vs Global?
US mixed but stable: SPY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY; EM leadership: EEM (1W: +5.09% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -7.76%) RECOVERY showing selective recovery.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation active but uneven: IWM (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +3.64%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +5.57% | 1M: -20.12%) RECOVERY; thematic corrections in parts of tech/skytech (CIBR (1W: -1.58% | 1M: +12.50%) CORRECTION).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Refation signal visible: CPER (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%) RECOVERY while gold weak: GLD (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) BELOW TREND indicating risk-on tilt but profit taking in safe-havens.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy soft: XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND; natural gas mixed/volatile: UNG (1W: -2.74% | 1M: +3.37%) CORRECTION.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: XLK and SOXX both timeframes positive (ABOVE TREND) confirming tech/semis leadership. Divergence: several industry/theme ETFs in CORRECTION (CIBR (1W: -1.58% | 1M: +12.50%) CORRECTION, SKYY (1W: -4.79% | 1M: +6.69%) CORRECTION) — minor divergence only.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor growth/semis exposure (XLK, SOXX) and regional risk via EEM while reducing exposure to energy/commodities and gold which are showing weakness; monitor credit spreads and VXX for regime inflection.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND, XRT (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND, GLD (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND; watch UNG (1W: -2.74% | 1M: +3.37%) CORRECTION for volatility.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 24.2 (complacency/fear barometer); HYG/LQD 0.7333 (credit stress pivot); XLK/XLF 3.4646 (growth vs financials tilt).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, but rising credit stress (HYG/LQD ↓) and mixed risk signals leave the market in a cautious posture. Tech/semis showing relative strength (XLK (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND) while commodities/energy and gold show weakness to monitor.
